source: Qwen3.5-9B (real shapes captured via module-level monkey-patch on torch_{chunk,recurrent}_gated_delta_rule, 16-token prefill + 5-token greedy decode, single layer = 1/24)
description: Two paths fire in Qwen3_5GatedDeltaNet.forward (line 510 / 522): recurrent path on decode (seq_len==1, has cache), chunk path on prefill or chunked-decode. Model config: num_v_heads=32, num_k_heads=16, head_k_dim=head_v_dim=128 (q/k already broadcast to Nv=32 by repeat_interleave). g is fp32 (forced by .float() on A_log + softplus). use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=True so the op pre-normalizes q,k internally. initial_state for recurrent comes from the cache as bf16; last_recurrent_state output is always fp32. End-to-end gate: bf16-realistic (atol 5e-2, rtol 1e-2) for fused outputs; --strict mode promotes to fp32 and gates at 3e-3.
